description: The open data potential for the geospatial characterisation of building stock on an urban scale: methodology and implementation in a case study - ASSOCIATE DATA is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Cristina Villanueva Díaz. This data set presents the results of geometric and thermal characterisation of buildings implemented in Bilbao City (Spain), applying the methodology proposed in the paper "The open data potential for the geospatial characterisation of building stock on an urban scale: methodology and implementation in a case study". Coverage: national (ES); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
